message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Reports → Detailed report → set the longest possible date range → Export → CSV/Excel, then Team → Export user info for the member list. Lands as CSV/Excel files on your disk, but note CSV/Excel needs Basic plan or higher; Free gets PDF only, capped at 31 days per report and 3,000 rows per PDF, so a year of Free-plan history means twelve separate PDF exports.
- **We pull it**, Instructions: click your profile icon (top right) → Profile settings → scroll to the API section → Generate, and do this from the workspace owner or admin account, the API only shows what your role can see in the UI. Copy the key and send it via secure means.

Let me know which route you would prefer (us pulling or you pushing)
notes: Free-plan exports are PDF only, capped at 31 days per report and 3,000 rows per PDF.
The API exposes only what the key owner's role can see in the UI.
